# Full Knowledge Base — AEM Frozen Food (AL-EKHLAS MANUFACTURING SDN. BHD.)

## Company
AL-EKHLAS MANUFACTURING SDN. BHD. (Reg. No. 202401022253 / 1568102-T), operating as AEM Frozen Food and under the trade name 真心食品, manufactures Chinese-style frozen food at its own plant in Semenyih, Selangor, Malaysia. The company supplies F&B chains, supermarkets, caterers, distributors and wholesalers, and takes on OEM and ODM contract manufacturing for food brands.

## Services
- **OEM / ODM contract manufacturing**: custom recipe development, flavour and spice-level adjustment, cut size and pack format to a brand's specification, private label packaging. Contract manufacturing is subject to a separate written agreement; the brand owner is responsible for its own label content, claims and market registrations.
- **B2B wholesale**: bulk supply for restaurant chains, hawker stalls, supermarkets, hotels, caterers and regional distributors.
- **Central kitchen supply**: pre-cut and pre-cooked frozen items that reduce skilled-labour and preparation requirements and keep output consistent across outlets.
- **Cold-chain logistics**: refrigerated delivery across Klang Valley and Peninsular Malaysia.
- **Samples**: sample requests and bulk quotations through the WhatsApp order desk.

## Catalogue — 51 SKUs in 10 categories

### 1. Satay & Skewers 烧烤串 (6 SKUs)
Packed 400g per packet; carton of 20 packets.
- Sate Ayam 鸡肉串 — marinated chicken on bamboo skewers.
- Sate Daging 牛肉串 — marinated beef.
- Sate Kambing 羊肉串 — marinated mutton.
- Sate Ayam Pedas Mala 麻辣鸡肉串 — chicken with Sichuan mala seasoning.
- Sate Daging Pedas Mala 麻辣牛肉串 — beef with Sichuan mala seasoning.
- Sate Kambing Pedas Mala 麻辣羊肉串 — mutton with Sichuan mala seasoning.
Preparation: grill, oven or air fryer.

### 2. Frozen Dumplings 饺子系列 (4 SKUs)
Packed 2kg per pack.

- Beef & Leek 牛肉大葱饺子 — minced beef with Chinese leek.
- Mutton & White Radish 羊肉白萝卜饺子 — minced mutton with white radish.

## Storage and Handling
All products are frozen. Keep at −18°C or below and keep the cold chain unbroken. Do not refreeze after thawing. Buyers must have adequate frozen storage ready before delivery. Shelf life stated on each product applies only while the product is held continuously at −18°C or below.

## Allergens
Products are made in a shared facility and may contain or come into contact with fish, crustaceans and shellfish, soy, peanut, tree nuts, sesame, gluten, egg and dairy. Where a buyer resells, repacks or serves the products, the buyer is responsible for ingredient and allergen disclosure to end consumers.

## Ordering, Delivery and Terms
- **Klang Valley (Kuala Lumpur & Selangor)**: scheduled refrigerated dispatch. Free delivery on orders RM1,000 and above; RM40 flat fee below RM1,000.
- **Peninsular Malaysia outstation (Penang, Ipoh, Melaka, Johor Bahru, Kuantan)**: free delivery on orders RM1,500 and above; RM40 flat fee below RM1,500.
- **Delivery time**: estimated 2–5 working days. All delivery dates are estimates and are not guaranteed.
- **Orders**: the website compiles a selection into a WhatsApp enquiry message. It takes no payment, and prices shown on it are reference only, exclude SST, and may change. A contract arises only when the company confirms an order in writing.
- **Inspection**: buyers check quantity, items, packaging and frozen condition on delivery, and report any issue by WhatsApp within two hours with photographs.
- **Factory visits**: by appointment at the plant address below.
- Full terms, refund policy and privacy notice are published on the website.
